findings.title: Unknown cost and known failure cost remain separate
findings.observation: The failed October 22 filter shows 2 runs: usage-002 with USD unestimated and usage-003 with USD 0.001420. Known input/output 2100/250 are shown alongside 1 incomplete run. Unestimated is explicitly not described as free.

findings.title: Changing future prices preserves historical currency, rates and estimate
findings.observation: Changed all four per-million prices and currency for the existing demo-cloud/demo-text pair, saved revision 2, reloaded, and reopened usage-003. Current values were CNY 1.23/4.56/0.12/0.78; historical values remained USD 0.8/3.2/0.2/1 and estimate USD 0.001420. New provider/model ID entry and future-run generation were not exercised.

findings.title: Agent directory, preview and retained input remain visibly distinct

findings.title: Mobile usage retains meaning but starts with a substantial header and filter region
findings.observation: At 412×915 the mobile usage first viewport fits the category selector, title, fixture explanation, dates and filter disclosure. The actual cost summary is below the first fold. No horizontal overflow or overlapping controls was observed. This is a density tradeoff, not a demonstrated blocked workflow.
